svg.title: The combat loop
svg.desc: Storyboard of a turn. 1: hit a weakness with an elemental technique, WEAK! 2: the enemy staggers into its tired pose. 3: ONE MORE! you act again at once. Then choose: another weak family (another One More, once per weak family a round), Baton Pass (a free switch that keeps your turn), or any other blow (it gets the +0.2 stagger bonus and the stagger ends). OVERFINISH: a blow that knocks the enemy out and earns One More leaves it lying for that action, and every hit on it pays Bits worth 10% of its damage.
svg.text: Only your elemental techniques stagger. A round runs from one normal action to the next.
Knock the enemy out with a blow that earns One More:
it stays down for that action, and every hit on it pays
Bits worth 10% of its damage, added to the battle's.
The stagger also ends when the enemy acts. A blow with no element never staggers.
